messages.content: Hi there — I'm JustinBot. How can I help you today?
That sounds really challenging. It's okay to feel this way. I'm here to talk and listen whenever you need. Let's take this one step at a time.

I'm genuinely concerned about your safety and well-being. You deserve support from professionals trained to help. Please reach out to a crisis service:

🌍 **US**: Call 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or text HOME to 741741
🇬🇧 **UK**: Call 116 123 (Samaritans) or text SHOUT to 85258
🌐 **International**: Visit findahelpline.com

Your life has value. These feelings can change. Please talk to someone.
Goodbye — I hope you're doing okay. Take care of yourself.
